title.narrative: Enhancing private sector-led economic growth in Dilijan and adjacent communities

description.narrative: The Overall Objective of the Action is to enhance economic growth and job creation in the enlarged Dilijan community. The enablers to tackle this growth are (1) implications of social economy cooperation of enterprises in business associations and cooperatives, (2) institutional support to business from advisory and administrative matters to education and outsourced services, (3) business clusters bringing the members of sectorial value chains together, both physically and virtually.
